Job Title: Business Systems Analyst / Solutions Delivery Manager
Text: It was wonderful to work with Kiran Vaidya as a Product Management Instructor at Intellee. He is proactive, energetic and perfectly organized. The wealth of Product Management knowledge that he has will benefit not only the aspiring Product Managers but also those who have been in the space for quite some time & want to enhance their skill set. Kiran is very passionate about Technology and Product Management & will definitely be an asset to an organization.
